title: Prōnōmina Persōnālia
subtitle: Fōrmae prōnōminum ἐγώ et σύ per cāsūs (ut vocābula memoranda), et fōrmae encliticae eōrum.
objectives: Recitāre fōrmās prōnōminis ἐγώ (ego) per nōminātīvum, accūsātīvum, genetīvum, datīvum
Recitāre fōrmās prōnōminis σύ (tū) per eōsdem cāsūs
Distinguere fōrmās fortēs (ἐμοῦ, ἐμοί, ἐμέ) ā fōrmīs encliticīs (μου, μοι, με) et scīre quandō quaeque adhibeātur
Legere sententiās simplicēs cum hīs prōnōminibus in variīs cāsibus

content.intro: Μελίτη τὸ βιβλίον ἔχει. Ἀγάθων λέγει· δίδωσί μοι τὸ βιβλίον; Μελίτη λέγει· οὐχί, τοῦτο ἐμόν ἐστιν, οὐ σόν. Notāvistī: μοι, ἐμόν, σόν — “mihi”, “meum”, “tuum”. Hodiē discis fōrmās plēnās prōnōminum ἐγώ et σύ, ut sententiās sīcut hanc iam plēnē intellegās.
content.explanation:
Μελίτη τὸ βιβλίον ἔχει. Ἀγάθων λέγει· “Δίδωσί μοι τὸ βιβλίον;” Μελίτη λέγει· “Οὐχί· τοῦτο ἐμόν ἐστιν, οὐ σόν.” Ἀγάθων λέγει· “Ἀλλὰ ἐμοὶ δίδωσιν ὁ διδάσκαλος, οὐ σοί!” Μελίτη λέγει· “Σὲ φιλῶ, ὦ φίλε, ἀλλὰ τὸ βιβλίον ἐμόν ἐστιν.” (Melitē librum habet. Agathōn dīcit: “Dat mihi librum?” Melitē dīcit: “Nōn — hic meus est, nōn tuus.” Agathōn dīcit: “Sed mihi dat magister, nōn tibi!” Melitē dīcit: “Tē amō, amīce, sed liber meus est.”)

Notāvistīne μοι (enclīticum, ūsus normālis) versus ἐμοί/ἐμόν (fortis, cum ēmphasī vel post praepositiōnem)? Sīcut Latīnum habet ego, mē, meī, mihi, Graecum habet fōrmās analogās prō ἐγώ et σύ — sed cum discrīmine additō: duplex sēriēs, fōrmae “fortēs” (cum accentū proprio, adhibitae prō ēmphasī vel post praepositiōnem) et fōrmae “encliticae” (sine accentū proprio, ex lēctiōne priōre, adhibitae in ūsū normālī nōn-ēmphaticō). Comparā Anglicum: “give it to ME [ēmphasis]” versus “give me [normāle] the book”.

rules.heading: a) Ἐγώ (Ego): Fōrmae per Cāsūs
rules.body:
CāsusFōrma FortisFōrma Enclītica
Nōminātīvusἐγώ(nūlla; nōm. numquam enclīticus)
Genetīvusἐμοῦμου
Datīvusἐμοίμοι
Accūsātīvusἐμέμε

rules.heading: b) Σύ (Tū): Fōrmae per Cāsūs
rules.body:
CāsusFōrma FortisFōrma Enclītica
Nōminātīvusσύ(nūlla)
Genetīvusσοῦσου
Datīvusσοίσοι
Accūsātīvusσέσε

Sēnsus generālis cāsuum (comparātiō cum Latīnō, sī iam nōtum): genetīvus ≈ genitīvus Latīnus (“meī, tuī”); datīvus ≈ datīvus Latīnus (“mihi, tibi”); accūsātīvus ≈ accūsātīvus Latīnus, obiectum dīrēctum (“mē, tē”).

rules.heading: c) Quandō Fōrma Fortis, Quandō Enclītica?
rules.body: Fōrma fortis (cum accentū proprio) adhibētur: (1) prō ēmphasī vel contrāstū — ἐμοὶ δίδωσιν, οὐ σοί “mihi dat, nōn tibi”; (2) semper post praepositiōnem — πρὸς ἐμέ “ad mē”; (3) semper in prīmā positiōne clausulae. Fōrma enclītica (sine accentū proprio) adhibētur in ūsū normālī, nōn-ēmphaticō, nōn post praepositiōnem: δίδωσί μοι τὸ βιβλίον “dat mihi librum” (ūsus normālis, nūlla ēmphasis in “mihi” ipsō).

examples: δίδωσί μοι τὸ βιβλίον. — Dat mihi librum. (μοι enclīticum, ūsus normālis)
ἐμοὶ δίδωσιν, οὐ σοί. — Mihi dat, nōn tibi. (ἐμοί fortis, propter contrāstum)
πρὸς ἐμέ. — Ad mē. (ἐμέ fortis, post praepositiōnem)
σέ φιλῶ. — Tē amō/dīligō. (σέ hīc fortis, prīma positiō)
λέγει με μαθητὴν εἶναι. — Dīcit mē esse discipulum. (με enclīticum, obiectum dīrēctum ōrātiōnis oblīquae)
τοῦτο ἐμόν ἐστιν, οὐ σόν. — Hoc meum est, nōn tuum.

commonMistakes.wrong: Adhibēre fōrmam encliticam (μου, μοι, με) post praepositiōnem, ut “πρὸς με”.
commonMistakes.right: Adhibēre semper fōrmam fortem post praepositiōnem: “πρὸς ἐμέ”.
commonMistakes.why: Praepositiōnēs semper requīrunt fōrmam fortem prōnōminis, numquam encliticam.

commonMistakes.wrong: Cōnfundere σοῦ (fortis, genetīvus “tuī”) cum σου (enclīticum, idem sēnsū sed sine accentū) tamquam sī essent verba dīversa.
commonMistakes.right: Recognōscere ambās fōrmās referre ad eundem cāsum eiusdemque prōnōminis, differentēs sōlum accentū (statūque fortī/enclīticō).
commonMistakes.why: Discrīmen fortis/enclīticī nōn est discrīmen significātiōnis, sed discrīmen ūsūs syntacticī et emphaticī.

commonMistakes.wrong: Crēdere prōnōmen nōminātīvum (ἐγώ, σύ) posse habēre fōrmam encliticam, sīcut cāsūs oblīquī.
commonMistakes.right: Recordārī nōminātīvum prōnōminis persōnālis numquam est enclīticum — semper cum accentū proprio, cum praesēns est (et plērumque omittitur, ex lēctiōne Salūtātiōnēs et Εἰμί).
commonMistakes.why: Sōlum cāsūs oblīquī (genetīvus, datīvus, accūsātīvus) habent duplicem sēriem fortem/encliticam.

exercises.title: Τὸ Βιβλίον: Ἐμὸν ἢ Σόν;
exercises.instructions: Lege, deinde responde secundum sensum, non verbum singulum.
exercises.passage: Μελίτη τὸ βιβλίον ἔχει. Ἀγάθων λέγει· “Δίδωσί μοι τὸ βιβλίον;” Μελίτη λέγει· “Οὐχί· τοῦτο ἐμόν ἐστιν, οὐ σόν.” Ἀγάθων λέγει· “Ἀλλὰ ἐμοὶ δίδωσιν ὁ διδάσκαλος, οὐ σοί!” Μελίτη λέγει· “Σὲ φιλῶ, ὦ φίλε, ἀλλὰ τὸ βιβλίον ἐμόν ἐστιν.”

items.explanation: Μελίτη τὸ βιβλίον ἔχει.

options: meus est, nōn tuus (ἐμόν, οὐ σόν)
items.explanation: “Τοῦτο ἐμόν ἐστιν, οὐ σόν.”

items.prompt: Quis, secundum Agathōnem, eī librum dat?
items.explanation: “Ἐμοὶ δίδωσιν ὁ διδάσκαλος, οὐ σοί!”
“Σὲ φιλῶ, ὦ φίλε.”

exercises.title: Quis Cui Dat? (Ex Sēnsū, Nōn Ex Rēgulā)
exercises.instructions: Relege sententiās suprā. Respondē ex sēnsū nārrātiōnis, nōn ex nōmine cāsūs.

items.prompt: “Δίδωσί μοι τὸ βιβλίον;” — Quis hoc rogat, et dē quō?
options: Agathōn rogat num Melitē librum sibi det
Melitē affirmat sē librum Agathōnī iam dedisse
items.explanation: Ἀγάθων λέγει· “Δίδωσί μοι τὸ βιβλίον;” — quaestiō, nōn affirmātiō.

items.prompt: “Ἀλλὰ ἐμοὶ δίδωσιν ὁ διδάσκαλος, οὐ σοί!” — Cui magister librum dat, secundum Agathōnem?
items.explanation: Ἐμοί (“mihi”) refert ad Agathōnem ipsum, loquentem; σοί (“tibi”) refert ad Melitēn, sed negātur (οὐ σοί).

items.prompt: Cūr Agathōn hīc adhibet ἐμοί (fōrmam fortem), nōn μοι (fōrmam encliticam simpliciōrem, quam ipse anteā adhibuit)?
options: quia contrāstum facit cum Melitē (“mihi, nōn tibi”) — ēmphasis
sine ratiōne; ambae fōrmae sunt semper intercambiābilēs
items.explanation: Contrāstus explicitus (οὐ σοί) requīrit fōrmam fortem — comparā cum μοι anteā, in ūsū normālī nōn-ēmphaticō.

items.prompt: “Σὲ φιλῶ, ὦ φίλε, ἀλλὰ τὸ βιβλίον ἐμόν ἐστιν.” — Quem Melitē amat, et quid tamen affirmat?
options: amat Agathōnem (σέ), sed librum suum esse dīcit (ἐμόν)
items.explanation: Σέ (“tē”) refert ad Agathōnem; ἐμόν (“meum”) refert ad librum, quī manet apud Melitēn.

exercises.title: Complē cum Fōrmā Rēctā
exercises.instructions: Comple spatia cum fōrmā rēctā prōnōminis, fortī an encliticā secundum contextum.

items.explanation: Ūsus normālis, nōn-ēmphaticus: fōrma enclītica μοι.
Post praepositiōnem πρός, fōrma fortis semper requīritur: ἐμέ.
Contrāstus explicitus (οὐ σοί) requīrit fōrmam fortem: ἐμοί.
Ūsus normālis, nōn-ēmphaticus, obiectum: fōrma enclītica με.
Possessiō ēmphatica hīc favet fōrmam fortem ἐμοῦ (litt. “librum meī est”).

exercises.title: Prōnōmina: Nunc Nōmina Rēgulam
exercises.instructions: Postquam sententiās intellēxistī et fōrmās rēctās ēlēgistī, nōmina explicitē rēgulam.

items.prompt: Quae fōrma adhibētur semper post praepositiōnem?
items.explanation: Post praepositiōnem, fōrma fortis semper requīritur (πρὸς ἐμέ, nōn *πρὸς με).
Μοι est fōrma enclītica datīvī prōnōminis ἐγώ.

items.prompt: Quandō adhibētur fōrma fortis (ἐμοί) potius quam enclītica (μοι)?
items.explanation: Fōrma fortis marcat ēmphasim/contrāstum; enclītica est ūsus normālis, nōn-ēmphaticus.

items.prompt: Quae fōrma est genetīvus fortis prōnōminis σύ?
items.explanation: Σοῦ (cum accentū circumflexō) est fōrma fortis; σου (sine accentū proprio hīc) est enclītica.

items.prompt: Habet nōminātīvus prōnōminis persōnālis (ἐγώ, σύ) fōrmam encliticam?
items.explanation: Nōminātīvus numquam est enclīticus; sōlum cāsūs oblīquī habent duplicem sēriem.

exercises.title: Vērum an Falsum
exercises.instructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

items.statement: Fōrmae fortēs et encliticae prōnōminum persōnālium habent significātiōnēs omnīnō dīversās.
items.explanation: Falsum: referunt ad eundem cāsum eiusdemque prōnōminis; differunt in ūsū syntacticō/emphaticō, nōn in sēnsū fundāmentālī.

items.statement: Post praepositiōnem, fōrma enclītica prōnōminis est adhibenda.
items.explanation: Falsum: post praepositiōnem, fōrma fortis semper requīritur.

items.statement: Ἐμοῦ, ἐμοί, ἐμέ sunt fōrmae fortēs cāsuum oblīquōrum prōnōminis ἐγώ.
items.explanation: Corrēctum: genetīvus, datīvus, accūsātīvus fortēs, respondentēs μου, μοι, με enclīticīs.

items.statement: Nōminātīvus prōnōminis persōnālis potest esse enclīticus, sī nōn ēmphaticus.
items.explanation: Falsum: nōminātīvus (ἐγώ, σύ) numquam habet fōrmam encliticam.

summary: Ἐγώ (ego): nōm. ἐγώ · gen. ἐμοῦ/μου · dat. ἐμοί/μοι · acc. ἐμέ/με (fortis/enclīticum).
Σύ (tū): nōm. σύ · gen. σοῦ/σου · dat. σοί/σοι · acc. σέ/σε (fortis/enclīticum).
Fōrma fortis: ēmphasis/contrāstus, post praepositiōnem, prīma positiō. Fōrma enclītica: ūsus normālis, nōn-ēmphaticus.
Nōminātīvus (ἐγώ, σύ) numquam est enclīticus; sōlum cāsūs oblīquī habent duplicem sēriem.
Theoria plēna cāsuum (cūr et quōmodo nōmina ipsa dēclīnentur) sequitur in Gradū II.
